reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and my first question is always whether it's really tested. A named lab and a report for my batch that I can check with the QR code is the first time I've seen that answered. At $24.99 I'd try one box.
objection: I already reorder Toplux or Goli when they run out. Is one lab report enough to make me switch, or is it just a nicer way to market the same thing? I'd also want to open the report and check that the numbers match.
would_change_my_mind: If I opened the batch report and the lab wasn't a real independent one, or the mg on the report didn't match the box, I'd drop it.
